paper.title: A two-dimensional growth process
paper.journal: Proc. 4th Berkeley Symp. Math. Statist. Prob. 4:223-239

headline: Eden 1961 growth (KPZ interface): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; compact bulk D=1.97, KPZ beta=0.346 (1/3), alpha=0.549 (1/2)

verdicts.gate: P1 compact bulk (D >= 1.85, density non-decaying) — NOT a fractal
P2 KPZ growth exponent beta in [0.24, 0.42] (target 1/3)
P3 KPZ roughness exponent alpha in [0.35, 0.60] (target 1/2), W_sat monotone in L

extra.framing: stochastic particle growth on a grid (hybrid)
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of Eden's compact bulk + KPZ rough interface

citations: Eden, M. (1961). A two-dimensional growth process. Proc. 4th Berkeley Symp. 4:223-239. KPZ scaling: Kardar, Parisi & Zhang (1986), Phys. Rev. Lett. 56:889.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful reproduction graded against the compact bulk dimension + KPZ growth/roughness exponents
